_readme: Convoy's update log, newest first. Shown once in the app after each update (What's new), on Profile > What's new, and at /updates on the website. Add a release at the top whenever a user-facing change ships. id must be unique and new ids must sort after old ones (use the date, plus -2 for a second release that day). icon is a MaterialCommunityIcons name.

releases.title: Links that show what they are

items.title: Link previews
items.text: Convoy links now unfurl in iMessage, Discord, WhatsApp and friends: who's inviting you, where the drive is heading, or a live arrival time.

items.title: Invite links for drives and clubs
items.text: Sharing a group drive or club sends a link instead of just a code. Opening it fills the code in for you.

items.title: What's new
items.text: A list of every update, under Profile in the app and at /updates on the website.

releases.title: Quick calls, live ETA and gas stops

items.title: Convoy quick calls
items.text: One tap to tell the whole group "Need gas", "Pull over", "Cop ahead" and more. Everyone sees it and hears it read out.

items.title: Share my ETA
items.text: Send anyone a live link while you navigate. They see your car on a map and when you'll arrive, no app needed.

items.title: Gas along the route
items.text: See the stations coming up on your route and add one as a stop in a tap.

items.title: Who's where
items.text: During a group drive, everyone is stacked down the left side with their speed and distance to the stop.

items.title: Drive to the convoy's destination
items.text: When the leader sets a destination you get the same one-tap route prompt as regroup points.

items.title: Real speed limit sign
items.text: The limit now sits on the speedometer as a proper road sign.

items.title: Faster route line
items.text: The blue route line shows up right away, even right after ending a drive.

releases.title: Regroup points, Twisty Roads and Camera Scouts

items.title: Regroup points
items.text: Someone got split up? The leader picks a gas station ahead and everyone gets routed there.

items.title: Twisty Roads
items.text: A route option that picks the curvy way, for when the drive is the point.

items.title: Car specs in the garage
items.text: Find your exact car by make and model (or VIN) and see horsepower, 0-60, drivetrain and more.

items.title: Camera Scouts
items.text: Report speed, red light and plate cameras. Once enough drivers confirm one, it goes on everyone's map.

items.title: Speed ring
items.text: The ring around your speed fills toward the limit and turns red when you're over.

items.title: Route options
items.text: Pick fastest, shortest, fewest turns or no highways.

items.title: Search by voice
items.text: Search over the map, with pinned places, suggestions and voice input.

items.title: Cameras on the map
items.text: Speed and red light cameras show where they are. Tap one for details.

items.title: Lanes, weather and recaps
items.text: Lane guidance at turns, weather along the route, and a nicer recap when you finish.
